gate: M6 prior-art sweep — the condition under which M6 was admitted to the v2 moonshot board
verdict: KILLED — both halves of the proposed write-up are prior art, and the literature is sharper on both

claims_tested.claim: emit succeeds <=> the invariant lies in the span of the probe basis
claims_tested.status: PRIOR ART, and known more sharply
claims_tested.evidence: Oellerich & Emelianenko state the failure trichotomy explicitly: a failure to produce sigma_i ~ 0 means (1) the library lacks the appropriate terms, (2) inadequate/noisy data, or (3) no conservation law exists. (1) IS the claim. They further supply a noise-calibrated cutoff sigma = sqrt(Np)*||eps||^{2/3} from perturbation theory (their Cor. 4.2) and a spectral-gap library-selection criterion max(sigma_{j-1} - sigma_j) — both strictly sharper than our fixed tau_rel = 1e-6.

claims_tested.claim: O4 — an over-rich polynomial basis can FALSELY emit by approximating an invariant outside its span
claims_tested.status: PRIOR ART, actively attacked in the literature
claims_tested.evidence: Ray 2026 names non-polynomial invariants and false positives as the target problem; pipeline includes log-basis Lasso (the same log-augmented basis tabula tried in R1) and a constancy gate plus diversity filter to remove spurious laws (the formalized version of our proposed out-of-sample guard), reporting FDR = 0.0 over nine systems. Broader literature: overcomplete polynomial libraries are strongly collinear and 'no regularisation tuning can provide a formal guarantee on the rate of false discoveries.'

instrument_upgrades_adopted: replace fixed tau_rel = 1e-6 with a noise-calibrated cutoff (Oellerich & Emelianenko Cor. 4.2)
adopt the spectral-gap library criterion max(sigma_{j-1} - sigma_j) instead of a hand-set ratio threshold
adopt a constancy-gate + diversity-filter false-positive guard (Ray 2026) in place of the ad-hoc out-of-sample check
unaffected: R2's cross-gate closure (bridge reimplementing ansatz 123 independently) is cross-validation between two independent implementations, never a novelty claim — its value is unchanged. O4 remains a real finding about OUR instrument; it is not a finding about the field.
taxonomy_note: By A2's taxonomy this is a species-1 (precision/instrument) wall: prescription is 'keep pushing, upgrade the instrument' — which is exactly what the three adopted upgrades do.
